scheme_name: Scheme for Reimbursement of Educational Expenses to Hearing Impaired Students Pursuing Special Higher Education Courses Inside or Outside the Union Territory of Puducherry
other_conditions: Applicant must have a disability of 40% or more
Applicant must have resided in the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Applicant must be enrolled in a full‑time special higher education course in a government‑recognized institution
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of entire fees from the first year of the course
